_comment: The relay servers the app offers for sessions over the internet (Collab → Session). This copy ships with the app; a newer one is fetched from https://www.tupi3d.com/relay_servers.json when there is one, so a server can be moved or added without a new build. `id` is what a device remembers its choice by -- never reuse one for a different place. See scripts/net_relay_directory.gd and devdocs/relay_server.md. `secure_port` and `cert` are the server's encrypted (DTLS) door and the certificate it answers with, which the app pins -- see scripts/net_tls.gd; a server listed without them is reached in the clear. The certificate is public; its key never leaves the server (a backup is kept outside the repository).
